description: This PHP source file defines the class `FormatWithEmptyString` which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. The class provides a method `getFormattedValue` that always returns an empty string, serving as a formatting strategy for values within the OrangeHRM maintenance purge strategy plugin.

classes.name: FormatWithEmptyString
classes.description: A class implementing `ValueFormatter` that returns an empty string for any input value.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns an empty string regardless of the input value.
